summary: The solution performs a fixed number of comparisons and arithmetic operations on one integer, while the complete legal input domain contains only the values 1 through 100.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The public contract restricts n to an integer from 1 through 100.

replacement_checks.evidence: Every input follows at most two comparisons, one parity operation, and one optional integer division, independent of n.
Regression covers n equal to 1 and 2, representative odd and even values, and both parity classes at the upper boundary.
